subject: QnA runbook and scheduling for SOC 2 / SIG intake
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@techhaven.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QnA runbook and scheduling for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for starting the intake. To keep momentum, we put together a short QnA runbook and a proposed call agenda to cover the SIG questionnaire and SOC 2 evidence handoff. Goal: identify owners, confirm evidence windows, and carve out a 45-minute slot for live access walk-through if needed.

Quick summary of the runbook (attached):
- Intake overview + timeline (who needs to be involved and when)
- Suggested owners for common artifact requests (logs, config screenshots, vendor attestations)
- Mapping doc: which CAIQ/SIG questions we typically map to Redwood artifacts
- Evidence handoff checklist and acceptable delivery formats

Can you share 2x 45-minute slots that work this week or early next? We can present the mapping doc and capture any TechHaven-specific requirements.

Attachments: runbook-call-agenda.pdf (one-pager), CAIQ-mapping-Redwood-TechHaven.xlsx

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Ben —

Thanks for the materials, looks useful. Natalie and I are available Thursday 11/19 10:30–11:15 PT or Friday 11/20 13:00–13:45 PT. Prefer the Thursday slot if you can do it. Also can you confirm whether Redwood will share the SOC 2 Type II report and the control matrix ahead of the call? That helps our security team triage questions.

We prefer to review artifacts via secure Drive links; we cannot accept large email attachments.

Cheers,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 17 Nov 2026 13:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: QnA runbook and scheduling for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Sam — thanks, Thursday 11/19 10:30 PT is on our side. Placing a calendar invite now for 45 minutes and setting up a secure folder.

Per your question on pre-reads: attaching the SOC 2 report PDF and a first-pass CAIQ mapping for TechHaven. The CAIQ mapping is intentionally high-level; we'll walk through the mapping logic on the call and mark items where we'll need TechHaven confirmation or additional evidence.

Action owners (initial):
- Evidence drops: Marissa Cole — will coordinate artifact collection and secure share link (runbook checklist attaches owners per artifact).
- Technical access / demo: Karthik Iyer — will lead any live log/config walkthroughs and note gaps for redaction or scope.
- Follow-up Qs & control clarifications: Ben Carter — I'll own post-call coordination and ensure deadlines are tracked in HubSpot.

Attachments shared via Drive (links in calendar invite): SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf, CAIQ-mapping-Redwood-TechHaven.xlsx, runbook-call-agenda.pdf

Notes for the call agenda:
1) 5 min intro + intake scope
2) 15 min CAIQ mapping walkthrough (highlight high-risk/owner items)
3) 15 min evidence handoff plan (who, format, deadlines)
4) 10 min next steps & timeline (including demo window if required)

If TechHaven prefers a separate narrower call to go deep on audit logs, we can schedule a follow-up with our infra team.

Ben

From: Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@techhaven.com>

Date: Thu, 17 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: QnA runbook and scheduling for SOC 2 / SIG intake

Ben / team —

Thanks for scheduling and for the quick turnaround on artifacts. A couple of things from our side to make the call efficient:
- Please flag which CAIQ items are 'out of scope' versus 'Redwood-managed' (we saw some TODOs in the mapping).
- For logs: we need clarification on retention windows and whether aggregated telemetry is available for the last 90 days (sample logs acceptable).
- Would prefer the SOC 2 report redacted for customer names; the PDF you uploaded looks fine but please confirm redaction status before we share internally.

If you can add a short table in the Drive folder that lists "artifact -> owner -> desired date", we'll pick owners on our side and drop our evidence by next Monday.

See you Thursday.

Best,
Natalie Brooks
Sr. Security Engineer, TechHaven
natalie.brooks@techhaven.com
